title: Remote Pi WebSocket v2
description: Nothing is replayed. subscribe_all gives every Agent's state, then overview events of every Agent. focus answers with a snapshot of one Agent (newest timeline page, streamed text, dialogs); after it, on this socket and in order, come only appended items, streamed text and shell output of that Agent, or timeline_reset (focus again for a new snapshot). Timeline items never change. HTTP serves only what never changes: older pages (GET /api/v1/agents/{id}/timeline?before=) and item bodies (GET /api/v1/agents/{id}/sessions/{sessionId}/items/{itemId}).

subscribeDrafts.description: Full pairing code only: receive pending drafts from voice clients.

subscribeAll.description: Receive agent_state for every Agent, then overview agent_event messages of every Agent.

serverTime.description: Server epoch milliseconds, to correct clock skew for activity times.

limit.description: Size of the snapshot's page, 50 by default.

focus.description: View one Agent in detail (null: none). Loads it if needed and answers with focus_state, or focus_error; replaces the previous focus and its watches.

watch.description: Start or stop tool_output for a running tool of the focused Agent, e.g. while its card is expanded.

disposition.description: For steer and follow-up: whether the running turn took the message or it waits in the queue.

queue.description: Messages waiting for the running turn.

event.description: Overview events of every Agent: agent_loaded (its backend started on demand), agent_start, agent_end {willRetry, aborted}, agent_settled, activity_changed {activity}, queue_update, safe_pause {state: requested|reached|paused|cancelled|finished}, session_info_changed, agent_unloaded, auto_retry_*, summarization_retry_*, extension_ui_*. For the focused Agent also bash_execution_start/update/end (output of user shell commands).

focusState.description: Snapshot of the focused Agent. Every detail message after it is newer.

live.description: Text streamed so far for the message being generated.

dialogRequests.description: Pending dialogs, to rebuild their controls in the transcript.

delta.description: More streamed text; adjacent tokens are coalesced.

clearLive.description: They record the streamed message: drop its streamed text.

timelineReset.description: The branch changed other than by appending: focus again for a new snapshot.

toolOutput.description: Output so far of a watched running tool, at most one per tool per 100 ms.

timelineItem.description: One displayable part of one recorded session entry; it never changes. A tool's call and result are separate items paired by toolCallId (a page never splits them); whether a call is running is the Agent's activity. Bodies of user, assistant and error items, and other bodies up to 256 characters, are inline; others load from the item endpoint, cacheable forever.

title.description: Tool name, shell command, or what a system item is.

status.description: tool_result and bash: how it ended.

agentStateUpdate.description: Current state of one Agent, sent for every Agent on subscribe_all.

activity.description: What the Agent is doing now, maintained by the server. Also pushed as agent event {type:'activity_changed', activity} on every change. Times are server epoch milliseconds; correct skew with subscribed_all.serverTime.

summary.description: Command, path or pattern, at most 80 characters

pauseRequested.description: A safe pause is pending: the run stops before its next model request. reached: a request was withheld and the run is winding down; it can no longer be withdrawn.

activity.description: Live activity plus dialog payloads and queue. Never persisted.

dialogRequests.description: Pending request payloads for rebuilding dialog controls, without submitted answers.
